breakfast.name: Pan con Tomate (Spanish Tomato Toast)
breakfast.description: One of Spain's simplest and most beloved breakfast dishes - toasted bread rubbed with garlic, topped with grated ripe tomato, excellent olive oil, and sea salt
ingredients: 1 slice rustic bread or small baguette
instructions: Toast bread until golden and crispy using oven grill or toaster
Cut garlic clove in half and rub over toasted bread surface while still warm
Grate tomato using box grater over bread, letting tomato pulp soak into bread
Discard tomato skin
Drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil
Sprinkle with sea salt to taste
Serve immediately while toast is still warm
breakfast.notes: Using box grater to create thick tomato sauce rather than chopping ensures proper thick consistency found in Spanish cafés
breakfast.fun_fact: Pan con tomate takes only five minutes from start to table. It is typically made with small crusty baguettes (bollería) and is quick enough for hurried mornings

breakfast.name: Churros (Spanish Fried Pastry)
breakfast.description: Golden Spanish fried pastry often served alongside thick hot chocolate for dunking. Can be served plain, dusted with cinnamon sugar, or filled with chocolate or custard
ingredients: Additional sugar and cinnamon for coating
instructions: Combine water, sugar, butter, and salt in saucepan
Bring mixture to boil over medium heat
Remove from heat and add flour, stirring until well combined into thick paste
Cool slightly
Transfer dough to churrera (churro maker) or piping bag with large star nozzle
Heat 2 inches of oil in deep pot to 375°F
Pipe 4-6 inch strips of dough directly into hot oil
Fry 1-2 minutes until golden on one side, then flip
Fry another 1-2 minutes until golden on other side
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
While still warm, roll in cinnamon sugar mixture
Serve warm with hot chocolate for dunking
breakfast.notes: Churros are best served immediately after frying while still warm. Oil temperature must be consistent for even cooking
breakfast.fun_fact: Churros are traditional Spanish breakfast often served alongside thick hot chocolate for dunking. Churros can also be filled with chocolate or custard cream

lunch.name: Gazpacho (Cold Tomato Soup)
lunch.description: Traditional Spanish cold soup from Andalusia - perfect for hot summer lunches. Made from fresh tomatoes and vegetables
instructions: Roughly chop tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion and garlic
Working in batches, blend vegetables until smooth
Strain through fine sieve for smoother texture or keep chunky
Stir in olive oil, vinegar, tomato juice, salt and pepper
Chill for at least 2 hours
Serve ice-cold with croutons and diced vegetables
lunch.notes: Gazpacho improves overnight as flavors meld. Can be made vegetarian by omitting fish sauce
lunch.fun_fact: Gazpacho is traditional Spanish lunch from Andalusia region, perfect for hot summer days
alternatives: Add sherry vinegar instead of red wine
